props.title: What types of projects do you typically handle?
props.content: We take on everything from small-scope feature work and custom module/plugin builds to enterprise-level integrations, performance and security overhauls, and full platform rebuilds on Drupal or WordPress.

props.title: Do you only work with Drupal and WordPress?
props.content: Those are our core specialties, but our team also works across the broader stack — custom APIs, headless front-ends, third-party integrations, and supporting infrastructure.

props.title: How long does a typical development project take?
props.content: It depends on scope. A focused integration or module build can ship in a few weeks, while larger platform projects typically run two to six months. We'll give you a concrete timeline after the Technical Assessment.

props.title: Do you offer post-launch support or maintenance?
props.content: Yes. Every engagement ends with a clean handoff, documentation, and optional ongoing support — either through our CMS Support plans or continued development work.

props.title: Can you help fix issues with an existing website?
props.content: Absolutely. We regularly step in to fix broken features, resolve performance issues, clean up inherited code, and finish stalled projects on existing Drupal and WordPress sites.
